reason: Original unary minus of signed int32 zero_point is undefined at INT32_MIN before the intended int16 narrowing; replace with uint32 modulo negation followed by the same int16 narrowing. This preserves the existing 16-bit wrap ordering and covers all int32 zero points.
configuration: LP64 little-endian two-complement signed integer narrowing, IEEE binary32 RNE; NaN/Inf/+-0 scales included; floating flags and traps unobserved

counterexample.kind: C signed integer overflow at original unary minus
